svg.title: Ethereum Infra Lab architecture
svg.desc: Cloudflare and nginx route web traffic to Grafana. Grafana queries Prometheus, which scrapes Nethermind, Lighthouse and node-exporter. Lighthouse uses the JWT-authenticated Engine API on Nethermind. RPC ports stay on the Docker network; P2P ports are published separately.

g.text: P2P ports published separately: Nethermind :30303 / Lighthouse :9010 (TCP + UDP)
